title: Freelancer Retainer System
audience: Freelancers who want legitimate recurring work after successful projects.
shortDescription: Turn completed projects into legitimate recurring revenue.
coreOutcome: Design continuing services that deliver continuing customer value.
problem: Recurring billing is only durable when recurring work solves an ongoing problem.
situation: Projects end cleanly, but valuable ongoing needs are left unstructured or handled ad hoc.
commonFailure: Inventing a retainer without continuing value creates misaligned expectations and weak retention.
methodology: Find recurring needs, define outcomes and boundaries, establish operating cadence, and review value.
whoItsFor: Freelancers with completed projects and genuine ongoing customer needs
whoItsNotFor: Anyone trying to charge recurring fees without recurring value

seo.title: Freelancer Retainer System | Prospect Foundry
seo.description: Turn completed development projects into recurring services that provide continuing value.
